messages:
pagerduty-bot: PAGER - GPU capacity exhaustion observed in eu-central2 (hosted-api-prod). autoscaler pending scale-up for ~16m, queue length > 1300, token latency spike. Severity: P2.
ashley: ack, I'm oncall. Investigating. which pools are affected?
noah: looks like pool 'eu-cc-gpu-pool-3' is at hardQuota limit from GCP side — scale requests are failing with 403 Quota exceeded. kube-autoscaler logs show repeated CreateInstanceGroup errors.
lena: +1 seeing a bunch of GCP quota denies in infra logs: `Compute Engine API: QuotaExceeded - GPUs (NVIDIA_TESLA)`. Also some zones in the region are healthy but our placement policy pins to eu-central2-a/b.
opsbot: Recent events: 1787654200 - autoscaler attempted 12 node adds; 1787654260 - GCP quota error returned; 1787654300 - request retry loop started.
ashley: Customer impact? any broad 5xxs?
customer-ops: We're seeing a higher rate of 429s on generation endpoints and a couple of larger customers reported soft timeouts. A few jobs in Dedicated customers' reserved capacity are unaffected. Impact mainly on Hosted API for long-context workloads.
sam: Can we hot-fix by routing new requests to eu-west1 or fallback model variants?
noah: We can route by policy but need to ensure model parity. Quick option: add routing rule to prefer eu-west1 when capacity in eu-central2 is unavailable. That avoids queue growth here. I'll prepare the rule.
lena: Meanwhile, can we free any preemptible / burst capacity? The pool has some nodes with pinned GPUs for infra tests, maybe evict them.
ashley: Action plan so far: 1) Add routing fallback to eu-west1 for non-geo-restricted requests. 2) Evict noncritical GPU workloads in eu-central2 to free slots. 3) Open quota request with GCP and escalate. 4) Communicate with affected customers.
ashley: noah, can you prepare the routing change? I'll start customer comms draft.
noah: preparing a canary routing override. Example config I'm testing:
```
# route override - prefer eu-west1 when eu-central2 is degraded
routes:
  - match: 
      header: region_preference
    action:
      primary: eu-central2
      fallback: eu-west1
      degrade_if: autoscaler_pending > 10m
```
noah: will roll to 10% first, then 50% if metrics improve.
lena: I'm running a quick audit: `gcloud compute regions describe europe-central2 --project=redwood-prod` to confirm quotas. Output snippet: `GPUS: limit=40 used=40`.
sam: Any quick wins on model configuration? Can we switch large-context inference to lower-memory quantized variant temporarily to reduce GPU per-request footprint?
noah: We have a quantized variant for the 70B model that uses ~0.6x memory. Switching live is possible but will need a short blackout for correctness checks. Prefer routing approach first.
ashley: Customer comms draft (short): "We're investigating increased latency and rate limits affecting some generation requests in eu-central2. Our mitigation includes routing traffic to nearby regions and freeing capacity. We're monitoring and will update in 30m." Thoughts?
customer-ops: Good. add note that Dedicated customers on reserved pools are unaffected if true.
ashley: Ops runbook updates: I'm creating incident->INC-4321. Assigning follow-ups: quota escalation (lena), routing change (noah), eviction plan (sam), customer comms (ashley).
opsbot: NOTICE - Eviction candidate list:
- infra-test-job-3 (low priority)
- nightly-benchmarks-eu (scheduled)
- ci-gpu-short (non-prod)
noah: Rolling routing canary now (10%). Will monitor error rate and queue length.
ashley: Monitor windows: check queue length metric `hosted.api.queue_length.eu-central2` and `token_latency_p99`. If queue drops -> promote.
lena: Quota request initiated to GCP support (case 987654321). Escalation level: high. ETA unknown, but asked for 50 GPU increase.
sam: Starting eviction for listed candidates. Running: `kubectl drain infra-test-job-3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`
noah: Canary at 10% shows queue delta: eu-central2 queue -5%, eu-west1 queue +4% (expected). token_latency_p95 improved by ~20% for canary.
ashley: Good. Promote to 50% roll.
noah: Promoted. Monitoring..
opsbot: Metrics snapshot at 1787654600: queue_length eu-central2=980 (down from 1300), autoscaler_pending=4m, token_latency_p99 down 18%.
customer-ops: Received reply from a Tier-1 customer: "Thanks for the quick action, seeing improvements on our end."
lena: GCP replied on case 987654321 asking for account-level justification and expected sustained usage. I've provided our expected steady-state and spike graphs.
sam: Evictions completed, freed ~6 GPUs in the pool.
noah: After 50% routing roll, overall region requests decreased enough that autoscaler pending operations stabilized. However quota remains at limit so further node adds will still fail if sustained.
ashley: Current status: routing fallback in place at 50%, evictions freed 6 GPUs, queue reduced ~25%, customers seeing improvement. Quota escalation pending. We'll keep this as an active incident until quota increase or permanent routing policy implemented.
ashley: Next steps logged in INC-4321: formalize cross-region fallback, automation to detect GCP quota denies and trigger routing, customer follow-up 1:1 for impacted accounts.
noah: logging a short postmortem template now - will capture root cause (insufficient region quota + placement constraints) and mitigation (routing fallback + eviction + quota request).
lena: Adding note: consider reducing placement affinity to spread across eu-central2-a/b/c and eu-west1 in future to avoid single-region quota cliffs.
ashley: Thanks all. If queue trends back up, page infra SRE. For now, monitoring in #incidents. :thumbsup:
opsbot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status=mitigated; summary=traffic routed to eu-west1 + evictions freed capacity; next_update=in 30m."
